appraisal_events.evidence: Nos fiançailles avaient pris une allure de procès et donnaient à Albertine la timidité d'une coupable... dès que je ne trouvais pas Albertine gentille, au lieu de lui dire que j'étais triste, je devenais méchant.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator retrospectively acknowledges that his jealousy turned the relationship into an interrogation and made him cruel rather than simply sad, a self-directed diminishment he himself registers.

status_effects.explanation: Her elaborate, self-admitted invention of an entire trip, along with a pattern of deflecting half-truths, clearly lowers her local credibility.
